board.intro: Ibhodi lihhovisi elizimele, elingathathi hlangothi kwezombusazwe. Lihlela, lihlola, lulawula imingcele, liqinisekise, lucwaninge, futhi liyalele ukubala kabusha. Alibali ngezandla. Ukuhlanganisa imiphumela kwenzeka kukhompyutha evikelekile.

Umdlalo uphinda ukubala amaphepha okuvota okhetho lwangaphambilini kukhishwe ilungu elishiyile njengomkhethwa (ukubala kabusha kwesihlalo esingenamuntu). ranked.intro: Hlela abakhethwa abaningi ongabafuna. Ukuhlela zonke izihlalo kugcina ivoti lakho liphila njengoba ukubala kuqhubeka. Iphepha lakho lokuvota liyimfihlo. Ikhodi yesitsha sakho ikuvumela ukuba uhlole ukuthi libalwe.
